question_type_rules.single_choice: default route for current extracted rows
question_type_rules.judge: only explicit binary true-or-false questions should be normalized to judge
question_type_rules.multiple_choice: do not bulk-import automatically in this round unless the extracted row already has an explicit multi-answer result

parse_status_policy.parsed: Normalized row is complete and can be imported by batch SQL into yk_question and yk_question_option.
parse_status_policy.needs_manual_review: Keep the row in staging for traceability, but do not import it until manual supplement or structure confirmation is complete.
parse_status_policy.ignored_noise: Noise-only source rows or non-question files may be kept in staging for traceability; batch SQL will ignore them.

noise_file_strategy.preferred_action: Do not load pure noise files into formal question tables.
noise_file_strategy.traceability_action: If the extraction result must keep the noise trace, load it into yk_question_import_staging with parse_status=ignored_noise and a review_reason.
